d: Long, straight ash-purple hair with long bangs and a side ponytail tied with a blue ribbon. Large, wide-set ash-purple eyes with a neutral, vacant expression on a youthful face. A slender build wearing a white collared shirt, a dark blue tie, short dark navy shorts, and thigh-high dark navy stockings, all layered under a long, oversized burnt-orange cardigan that drapes over the shoulders. A black choker is worn around the neck, and a black folder is held in the right arm.
